column3: Outdated: the ruling (published 2013-09-20) predates the Throne of Eldraine Comprehensive Rules update (announced in "Comprehensive Rules Changes", Eli Shiffrin, 2019-09-27; effective 2019-10-04), which added to CR 205.1b that an effect making an object a "[creature type or types] artifact creature" keeps its other card types and subtypes but replaces its existing creature types (before it, 205.1b let any "becomes an artifact creature" effect retain all prior subtypes; checked against the archived CR texts of 1999-2019); Chimeric Staff's ruling (2009-10-01) agrees with the current rule; the ruling's other parts (the other effect's P/T and types, 3/6 by later timestamp) still hold, and the engine follows the current rule (tests/rulings/r_p186_animated.rs, jade_statue_animated_by_another_effect_becomes_a_3_6_golem)

column2: Opponents who have left the game will not be counted
column3: Inconsistent with the other rulings on the same question (conclusion C; ruling 2022-06-10): about 15 cards' rulings from 2007 to 2024 count opponents who have since left the game, among them Spinerock Knoll 2007-10-01 and Sygg, River Cutthroat 2008-05-01 ('a player who was your opponent at the time they left the game'), Notorious Throng 2008-04-01, Chandra's Incinerator 2020-06-23 (a cost reduction too), Belbe, Corrupted Observer, Tymna the Weaver and Ludevic, Necro-Alchemist 2020-11-10, Moonshae Pixie 2024-04-12 (same set, same structure, added after this ruling) and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares 2024-09-20; the CR doesn't exclude them (800.4i's last-known-information sentence supports counting); see the provisional interpretation history-counts-players-who-left; the engine counts them (tested in tests/cards/value_results_history.rs, gnoll_war_band_counts_opponents_who_were_dealt_damage)
